name: unified_safe_system_e2r_lambdarank_stack_v1
support: same clean strict-double-cold folds 0/1/2 and full 11081 reaction candidates

training.cross_fit: held-out fold ranker trained only on the other two internal folds

hard_negative_rule: highest max expert z-score among non-positive candidates; ties by candidate id
random_negative_rule: deterministic query-keyed RNG from remaining non-positive candidates
next_if_pass: freeze a brand-new salted strict-double-cold confirmation, refit four base experts train-only, fit stacker only on development OOF assets, and reveal confirmation once

inference_scope.shortlist: union of four expert Top-50 lists, maximum 200 candidates
inference_scope.reranking: LambdaRank scores only the union shortlist
inference_scope.tail: all candidates outside the union preserve exact EnzGFM baseline relative order
inference_scope.reason: capture expert rescue candidates with two orders of magnitude lower meta-ranker cost while retaining a complete baseline-tailed ranking
